live_flags.what: The home says the law 'restates the tragedy of the commons and overshoot (Lloyd 1833; Hardin 1968; Meadows and others 1972)'; its record says it 'treats neither reserves nor delayed renewal', while the 1972 overshoot comes through delayed feedback. A reader may believe World3's overshoot is restated; 'restates the arithmetic of' or naming the missing delay would say what holds (cx-syscyb-senge-limits-to-growth).

The record says that where the outcomes open to each depend on the others 'a step may have none'; 05 says 'no existence is shown, and none is shown to fail'. If 'may' means not excluded, the two agree, but the record's wording can read as a shown failure.
